SQL_full_pool: WITH cr_counts AS(SELECT hub.node_id,hub.specNumber,count(cr.node_id)AS crCnt FROM Spec hub JOIN rel_MODIFIES x ON x.dst_id=hub.node_id JOIN CR cr ON cr.node_id=x.src_id WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL GROUP BY hub.node_id), ranked_releases AS(SELECT c.*,rk.node_id AS rk_id,CAST(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')AS INTEGER)AS releaseInt,row_number()OVER(PARTITION BY c.node_id ORDER BY CAST(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')AS INTEGER)DESC)AS rank FROM cr_counts c JOIN edge ir ON ir.dst_id=c.node_id AND ir.rel_type='IN_RELEASE_OF' JOIN Spec rk ON rk.node_id=ir.src_id), density_rows AS(SELECT r.specNumber,r.crCnt,count(s.node_id)AS secCnt,round(1.0*r.crCnt/count(s.node_id),2)AS density FROM ranked_releases r JOIN rel_BELONGS_TO_SPEC bs ON bs.dst_id=r.rk_id JOIN Section s ON s.node_id=bs.src_id WHERE r.rank=1 GROUP BY r.node_id,r.specNumber,r.crCnt)SELECT specNumber,crCnt,secCnt,density FROM density_rows ORDER BY density DESC

reference_query: MATCH (hub:Spec)<-[:MODIFIES]-(cr:CR) WHERE hub.specRelease IS NULL WITH hub, count(cr) AS crCnt MATCH (rk:Spec)-[:IN_RELEASE_OF]->(hub) WITH hub, crCnt, rk ORDER BY toInteger(replace(rk.specRelease,'Rel-','')) DESC WITH hub, crCnt, collect(rk)[0] AS latestRk MATCH (latestRk)<-[:BELONGS_TO_SPEC]-(s:Section) WITH hub, crCnt, count(s) AS secCnt RETURN hub.specNumber AS specNumber, crCnt, secCnt, round(1.0 * crCnt / secCnt, 2) AS density ORDER BY density DESC LIMIT 5
